description: This file defines the CachesConfig interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.common package, providing configuration access methods for cache-related settings in the Concierge service, including methods to get ask timeout and cache configurations, as well as an enum of known config value defaults.

classes.name: CachesConfig
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for retrieving cache configuration settings and an enum for known configuration values.

classes.name: CachesConfig.CachesConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration that implements KnownConfigValue, providing default configuration path expressions and values for cache settings, specifically the ask timeout.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration configured for waiting on entity shard regions, representing an ask timeout duration.

methods.name: getIdCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration settings for the ID cache.

methods.name: getEnforcerCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration settings for the enforcer cache.
